P01.rationale: No human portrait or founder figure appears anywhere on the page; the hero image is an abstract geometric graphic.

P05.rationale: There are no case study sections or client portraits present on this page.

P07.rationale: No press logos, rating cards, review grid, or testimonials are present anywhere on the page.

P10.rationale: The step numerals (1–5) are small inline labels, not oversized decorative ghost numerals or large quote glyphs.

P11.rationale: No charts, before/after comparisons, or cost-math visualisations are present; only text-based process steps appear.

P12.rationale: The upper half has a hero image and headline block, but the lower half of the page is largely empty below the five-column process grid, leaving the sheet feeling under-filled.

P13.rationale: The hero banner uses a light geometric/abstract texture, but the rest of the page is flat white with no atmospheric treatment.

P14.rationale: The hero image has a light, faded treatment that keeps it unobtrusive, but no text is overlaid on it so a scrim is not critically tested.

P16.rationale: No device or product mockup (phone, laptop, book) appears anywhere on the page.

N07.rationale: The abstract geometric hero graphic feels like a generic stock illustration with no specific business context or real imagery.

N08.rationale: The bottom third of the page is entirely blank white space with no content, creating a large purposeless dead zone.

N10.rationale: No text is placed directly over a busy photo; the hero image and text blocks are cleanly separated.
